productIdea: 黎明書局同時是一個外文館藏的中文閱讀入口：canonical Work 保持原語言身份，中文由閱讀層即時生成，而不是偽裝成已出版中文譯本。

foreignAdmission.goal: 把既有非中文 acquisition pools 按與中文相同的 identity/provenance/rights/admission 規則轉成 canonical Works。
foreignAdmission.rule: source scale is not collection size; only normalized, deduplicated, rights/access-classified Work identities count as canonical collection.

instantChineseReading.goal: 對符合條件的非中文 canonical Works 提供即時繁體中文閱讀層。
instantChineseReading.rule: translation is a reader capability and never creates a second canonical Chinese Work.

existingChineseTranslationReferencePolic.principle: 已存在但因版權不能收錄的正式中文譯本，可以作為受限制的翻譯參考訊號，但不能因此被複製、重建或作為本站譯文的替代來源。
allowedUses: 書名、人名、地名、機構名等既有慣用譯名的 bibliographic verification
神學與歷史專名的術語一致性核對
確認某作品已有中文出版史及版本關係
在法律/授權允許的檢索或有限片段範圍內，用於 terminology/alignment quality signals
forbiddenUses: 抓取受版權保護的完整中文譯本建立本站全文
逐段照抄或近似重建現有譯本
把受版權中文譯本放入 translation cache
把機器譯文標成某出版社/譯者的版本
用既有譯本規避原本不能收錄的版權限制
existingChineseTranslationReferencePolic.authority: 原語言 source text remains translation authority; existing Chinese editions are bibliographic/terminology references only unless their rights explicitly permit fuller use.

cachePolicy.publicDomainOrOpen: chapter/segment translations may be persisted and reused
cachePolicy.copyrightRestricted: translation generation, persistence and redistribution depend on source and transformation rights; default to the least persistent lawful mode
cachePolicy.existingCopyrightedChineseEdition: never cache its text merely as a reference source

identityRule: A foreign Work with an instant Chinese reading layer remains one Work. A separately published Chinese translation is a distinct Edition relation only when its bibliographic identity is recorded; it is not automatically an ingestible asset.
strategicEffect: This lets the large foreign-language acquisition base become directly useful to Chinese readers without waiting for licensed Chinese editions, while keeping provenance, copyright boundaries and edition identity explicit.
